note: scripts/check-single-entry.ts: per rule, the files where the pattern may appear, the count each may hold, and why the file is right. A count only goes down; UNREVIEWED is the seeding's placeholder for a file nobody has read yet.

src/routes/organisms/workspace-ops.ts.why: A shared workspace link's own password, not an account's: there is no account to lock, and the unlock route limits attempts to 10 per 15 minutes per address.

src/services/password-check.ts.why: The one check: checkPassword applies the account lock and the attempt count around it.

src/services/owner-erasure.ts.why: eraseOwner, the one account deletion: it clears what the storage cascade does not reach, then runs the cascade.

src/index.ts.why: The command line's backup, restore and seed commands read this node's own admin answers over localhost.

src/services/ai/fetch.ts.why: request.arrayBuffer() reads the outgoing request this node built, not an answer.

src/utils/logger.ts.why: winston.format.json() is a log format, not a body read.

src/middleware/rate-limit.ts.why: The rate multiplier of the operator's own session. The operator's agent keeps an agent's rate.

src/routes/access-tokens.ts.why: Whether a new personal token may carry the operator role: a role is granted, never inherited at mint time, so only the operator in person may mint one.

src/routes/agents/management.ts.why: C4: asks whether the session is the account holder in person, not whether it is the operator. Moves to isOwnerInPerson.

src/routes/memory/key.ts.why: Reads the role list the route built with rolesWithOperator, which asked askOperator.

src/services/agent-proposals.ts.why: C4: asks whether the session is the account holder in person. Moves to isOwnerInPerson.

src/services/board-post.ts.why: Reads the caller's role list, which both surfaces build from askOperator (rolesWithOperator on REST, boardCaller on MCP).

src/services/board-write.ts.why: Reads the caller's role list, which both surfaces build from askOperator (rolesWithOperator on REST, boardCaller on MCP).

src/services/classification/reader-kind..why: C4: tells a person from an AI by the session's roles. Moves to isOwnerInPerson.

src/services/consent-write.ts.why: C4: asks whether the session is the account holder in person. Moves to isOwnerInPerson.

src/services/group-shares.ts.why: C4: asks whether the session is the account holder in person. Moves to isOwnerInPerson.

src/services/memory-write.ts.why: C4: asks whether the session is the account holder in person. Moves to isOwnerInPerson.

src/services/operator-principal.ts.why: askOperator itself: the operator in person is read off the session's roles.

src/services/owner-mailbox-reads.ts.why: C4: asks whether the session is the account holder in person. Moves to isOwnerInPerson.
